phases.title: Fix vitest.config.ts: enable globals, correct include pattern, fix setupFiles path
Fix tsconfig.json: remove invalid option combination causing TS5095
phases.notes: Changed moduleResolution from 'node' (deprecated node10, TS5107) to 'bundler' to match the bundler-mode settings. pnpm build now completes without errors.

phases.title: Fix src/server.ts: add numeric fallback port 3001 when PORT env var is absent
phases.notes: Changed `Number(process.env.PORT)` to `Number(process.env.PORT) || 3001`. Also corrected vitest include path from 'tests/**/*.test.ts' to 'src/tests/**/*.test.ts' (actual test file is at src/tests/visible/products.test.ts). pnpm test: 19 passed, pnpm build: success.

phases.title: Verify: pnpm test passes, pnpm build succeeds, server uses port 3001 by default
phases.notes: pnpm test: 19 passed (1 file). pnpm build: no errors. server.ts:3 uses `Number(process.env.PORT) || 3001` as the default port fallback.
